name: What needs to be done before bathroom drywall can be hung?

mainEntity.name: What needs to be done before bathroom drywall can be hung?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before drywall hanging begins, ensure all rough-in plumbing, shower valves, electrical wiring, and bathroom exhaust fan ductwork are inspected and completed. Check that framing is plumb, level, and free from past moisture rot or active leaks. Installing blocking for towel bars, grab bars, and heavy vanity mirrors should also happen before drywall covers the studs. You will need to confirm whether your planned tile requires specific backer thickness so the drywall transitions sit flush with the tile underlayment. Having these elements verified avoids cutting into fresh drywall later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Complete all plumbing, electrical, and exhaust rough-ins, add solid wood backing for towel bars and grab bars, and verify stud alignment before hanging drywall.
